</a>
<h3>Enum Constant Detail</h3>
<a id="TIME_DEPENDENT">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>TIME_DEPENDENT</h4>
<pre>public static final&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">TrafficOptimizationMode</a> TIME_DEPENDENT</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Traffic optimization is enabled, the shape of the route will be adjusted according to the traffic situation that
 depends on the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#departureTime"><code>RouteOptions.departureTime</code></a> or <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#arrivalTime"><code>RouteOptions.arrivalTime</code></a>. As a result, streets with heavy traffic
 will be avoided whenever possible.
 Note that this mode enables traffic-aware routing.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="LONG_TERM_CLOSURES_ONLY">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>LONG_TERM_CLOSURES_ONLY</h4>
<pre>public static final&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">TrafficOptimizationMode</a> LONG_TERM_CLOSURES_ONLY</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Only long-term road closures are taken into account. Both <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#departureTime"><code>RouteOptions.departureTime</code></a>
 and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#arrivalTime"><code>RouteOptions.arrivalTime</code></a> are ignored, and the route will be shaped disregarding all
 the available current and historical traffic information, except long-term road closures.
 Note that this mode disables traffic-aware routing regardless of other settings.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="DISABLED">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>DISABLED</h4>
<pre>public static final&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">TrafficOptimizationMode</a> DISABLED</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Traffic optimization is completely disabled, including long-term road closures. Both <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#departureTime"><code>RouteOptions.departureTime</code></a>
 and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#arrivalTime"><code>RouteOptions.arrivalTime</code></a> are ignored, and the route will be shaped disregarding all
 the available current and historical traffic information. Note that seasonal closures are not excluded. To exclude seasonal closures,
 use <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-roadfeatures#SEASONAL_CLOSURE"><code>RoadFeatures.SEASONAL_CLOSURE</code></a>.
 Note that this mode disables traffic-aware routing regardless of other settings.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
